item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Pretty simple and not incredibly interesting. However, it has some sort of charm to it, and the Foundation recruiting (if viable) and giving psychological aid to anyone under its effects is a lot better than "DESTROY AND AMNESTICS". I think the worst part about this would be sleeping while under its effects. Ew.

From the moment an instance of SCP-942-1 is ingested, the consumer's bodily fluids will take on the appearance of blood the moment they leave the body of the subject.

The two "from the moments" here make this sentence read awkwardly. Maybe "From the moment an instance of SCP-942-1 is ingested, the consumer's bodily fluids will take on the appearance of blood as soon as it leaves the body of the subject." ??

EDIT: Although, I do agree with Gene R. If it looks/quacks/sounds/talks/walks like a duck, it's blood.

Also also:

SCP-942-1 appear to be colored gumballs of standard (2.53cm) size.

They "appear" to be colored gumballs, because they are colored gumballs. Just anomalous ones.

Voct sees it the same way I do. Even at the max value for minimum age, you have someone who looks like a 9 year old. It's hard to find an 18 year old person who could still 'pass' for 9.

I'm reminded of the old saying of not fighting too long with dragons, lest ye become a dragon yourself. I find it hard very likely that none of the 'senior staff' even REMEMBER their humanity, whether it's Dr. Bright stuck inside the Imortality medallion, Dr. Gears unable to feel ANY emotions after dealing with the horrors, or Dr. Alto Clef and his 'sinister' demeanor; the Foundation has monsters guarding other monsters, all to keep the ignorant sheep happy and ignorant of the horrors behind every corner, every shadow…

Civilians contaminated be an SCP would typically be 'contained' or 'disposed,' depending on circumstances.

One thing even I have trouble remembering sometimes is that the Foundation does not, CAN NOT, care about individuals.

Remember SCP-231. The Foundation is doing horrible, terrible, [DATA EXPUNGED] things to a pre-teen girl daily, in order to prevent an end-of-the-world scenario. The Foundation works to protect Humanity, regardless of the number of Humans they need to kill to do so.

All of these efforts are ultimately doomed, but they must continue, to fight for one more breath for Humanity, and one more, and one more…. until someone finally slips up and the next breath is Humanity's last.
